identity.version_truth: 0.0.0 remains the inventory slot until an actual checkpoint and model card exist

student_size.selection_rule: Choose the smallest license-compatible student that passes the division baseline and fits measured runner memory/latency/cost; this is a target, not a claim that a model is available or trained

tokenizer.reference_rule: Use the exact tokenizer shipped with the pinned base-model ID and immutable revision; store tokenizer files and SHA-256 beside each division checkpoint
tokenizer.division_specific_override: Allowed only when the division benchmark proves a benefit and tokenizer compatibility/migration tests pass

training.strategy: SFT plus LoRA/QLoRA by default; full fine-tuning only after compute benchmarking; DPO only with separately approved preference data
training.distillation: Use teacher-generated targets only when teacher license, output-use terms, data classification, provenance, and human review permit it; retain teacher ID/revision and teacher-evaluation evidence
training.weight_ownership: Each division owns its adapter/full-weight checkpoint, optimizer state where retained, training config, dataset lineage, and model card; shared base weights are immutable references, not silently merged weights

schedule.planner_behavior: One fair-share division lane per five-minute tick; full fleet preflight every six hours
schedule.actual_weight_training_trigger: Only when a new approved job has rights-cleared data, a pinned base model/tokenizer, an available compute slot, and an explicit compute approval
schedule.retry_policy: bounded retries with failure classification, quarantine, and no infinite retry loops

teacher_policy.coordinator: Buddy Bootcamp curriculum and teacher orchestration
teacher_candidates: approved external teacher APIs where data classification permits
teacher_policy.proprietary_closed_model_weights: never copy or claim access; API use is inference only and does not grant weight or training rights

promotion.promotion_action: independent review only; no automatic production traffic change

truth: This policy defines a per-division model lifecycle plan. It does not select a base model, provision compute, train weights, prove teacher availability, or certify any division.
